data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A test constrains its subject when the test asserts a property that the mutation must violate to survive, and merely describes it when the test asserts a property the mutation can bypass by changing what the test reads. The 1-of-9 compile.py mutation was lost because the guard checked declared data, not added behaviour: the mutation added a behaviour that no declared field recorded. The 4/4 to 6/7 modules constrained their mutations because their guards checked executed behaviour, which the mutations could not avoid. The 3-of-26 result is a census of how many guards check declarations versus executions.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the lost compile.py mutation also changed a declared field but was still missed, then declaration-checking is not the differentiator.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If a behaviour-checking guard in one of the 4/4 modules also missed an added-behaviour mutation, the mechanism is not sufficient.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 3-of-26 mutations were all behaviour-adding but only some were caught, then the guard type alone does not explain the distribution.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the author's own reports show that declaration-checking guards caught mutations elsewhere, the dichotomy is too strong.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Declared-data guards are vulnerable to added-behaviour mutations because they inspect a static surface that the mutation can leave unchanged. Executed-behaviour guards are robust because they inspect the trace, which the mutation must alter to have any effect. The distribution follows the ratio of declaration-checking guards to behaviour-checking guards in each module. compile.py's lost mutation was an addition that no declared field could distinguish from the original.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
